plugins.name: tvboxtools
plugins.description: Set up Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV boxes from your computer over ADB: find the box on Wi-Fi or USB, read its state, install apps with SHA-256 checks, make a launcher the HOME app, test it across a reboot and get a report of every command.
